summary: RI70 KV95 is a frameless inrunner torque motor in the CubeMars RI portfolio. The manufacturer lists rated voltage 24/36/48 V, no load speed 1956/2934/3912 rpm, rated torque 0.94 Nm, mass 270.4 g.
